column2: The UL Relative Time of Arrival (TUL-RTOA) is the beginning of subframe i containing SRS received in LMU j, relative to the configurable reference time [13], [14]. The reference point [14] for the UL relative time of arrival shall be the RX antenna connector of the LMU node when LMU has a separate RX antenna or shares RX antenna with eNB and the eNB antenna connector when LMU is integrated in eNB.
